content.text:
Finding submitted.

**Classification: deviation (LICENSE, preferred target)**

- **§ 12.1 (p0149)** is the operative grant: "nonexclusive, **revocable** license" to "Customer" only — and § 14.17 (p0202) shuts the door on any implied extension ("No other licenses or rights ... are granted"). "Customer" is defined as Bluefly, Inc. alone, so affiliates/contractors are excluded with no path to add them, and the licence is revocable at IBM's discretion: walk-away territory, and it fails even the fallback affiliate element.
- **Already met:** § 7.0(c) (p0085) gives an *irrevocable, paid-up* Type II Materials licence; § 14.10 (p0188) permits assignment of the Agreement to a successor by merger, consolidation or acquisition (successor transferability).
- **Redline (validated ok:true):** (1) delete "revocable" in § 12.1; (2) one short sentence extending that licence to Affiliates and contractors acting on our behalf and limiting IBM termination to our uncured material breach; (3) add "perpetual" to the paid-up Type II grant. No survival, notice-condition, or other non-element extras were added, and the Type II "Enterprise only" scope and all unrelated wording are preserved verbatim.
